ev_0005.summary: Consolidated geometry for the 490x340 figure using verified labels A(53,288), B(316,287), C(434,51), D(171,51), E(106,181), F(118,288), G(195,217), N(158,288). Solid edges: AB along the bottom (A to B, through F and N), BC (right side), CD (top, horizontal), DA (left side, passing through E), EF (short vertical from E down to F), EG and GB (two solid pieces meeting at G with a visible bend), and CG (solid, from C to G). Dashed construction lines: CE (C through E), DB (D to B), EN (E to N), and NG (N to G). The CV detector reported no right angles and none are claimed. A circle hypothesis (center ~(243,168), r~121) is weakly supported by partial arcs and kept as a candidate only. Several CV style labels conflict with the supervisor's note: CG was reported solid rather than dashed, and EGB was reported as two segments rather than one straight line through G. The CV geometry is kept as measured.
